exec(open("fp.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---- matrix salt-bridge network integrity (AlphaFold models) ----
def network(acc):
    res=parse_pdb(f"af/{acc}.pdb"); segs,ax,cen,sig,net=frame(res)
    D=[s+2 for s in sig]; K=[s+5 for s in sig]
    out=[]
    for d in D:
        for k in K:
            if abs(d-k)<6: continue
            # min distance between charged group atoms
            da=[v for n,v in res[d]["atoms"].items() if n in ("OD1","OD2","OE1","OE2")]
            ka=[v for n,v in res[k]["atoms"].items() if n in ("NZ","NH1","NH2","NE")]
            if not da or not ka: continue
            dist=min(np.linalg.norm(x-y) for x in da for y in ka)
            if dist<6.0: out.append((f"{res[d]['aa']}{d}", f"{res[k]['aa']}{k}", round(float(dist),2)))
    return sig,sorted(out,key=lambda t:t[2])
for nm,acc in [("MRX20","P43617"),("CTP1","P38152"),("SFC1","P33303"),("AAC2","P18239")]:
    sig,out=network(acc); print(f"{nm:6s} signature@{sig}  matrix salt bridges <6A: {out}")

# ---- figure: contact point residues across substrate classes ----
T=pd.read_csv("contactpointII_plus8.tsv",sep="\t")
T=T[T.carrier!="AAC2"]
order=["tricarboxylate","dicarboxylate","oxodicarboxylate","nucleotide","phosphate","cationic aa","acylcarnitine","SAM","unknown"]
T["k"]=T.substrate_class.map({c:i for i,c in enumerate(order)})
T=T.sort_values(["k","carrier"])
cols=["cp2_anchor","pos_p1","pos_p4","pos_p8"]
colnames=["CP-II anchor\n(R/K)","+1","+4","+8\n(citrate marker)"]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.6,7.2))
def colr(s):
    a=s[0]
    return "#c0392b" if a in "KR" else ("#2471a3" if a in "DE" else ("#7d8f3a" if a in "NQSTYH" else "#9aa0a6"))
for yi,(_,row) in enumerate(T.iterrows()):
    for xi,c in enumerate(cols):
        v=str(row[c])
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((xi,yi),1,1,facecolor=colr(v),alpha=.30,edgecolor="white",lw=1.5))
        ax.text(xi+.5,yi+.5,v,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9,
                fontweight="bold" if row.carrier=="MRX20" else "normal")
    ax.text(-0.15,yi+.5,row.carrier,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9.5,
            fontweight="bold" if row.carrier=="MRX20" else "normal")
    ax.text(4.15,yi+.5,row.substrate_class,ha="left",va="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#444")
ax.set_xlim(-2.6,6.6); ax.set_ylim(0,len(T)); ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.axis("off")
for xi,n in enumerate(colnames): ax.text(xi+.5,-0.25,n,ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("Contact point II (helix H4) of SLC25 carriers\nArg at the +8 position occurs only in citrate/tricarboxylate carriers; MRX20 has Gln201",
             fontsize=10.5,pad=28)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
